title: Cocycle laws for labels in a pulled-back splitting
statement: Let R,H be commutative rings, g in R, iota:R -> H, and C a domain H-algebra with h=iota(g) nonzero in C. Let rho be an H-algebra action of a group G on C. Let p:Y -> Spec R and t:T -> Spec R, with k:D(h) in Spec C -> T over Spec R. Suppose delta splits pullback p t into d copies of T over T. Define a(g,i) by precomposing the i-th pulled-back section with the restricted Spec map of rho(g), lifting with k into pullback p t, applying delta, and reading the unique coproduct index at the zero prime. Then a(1,i)=i and a(gh,i)=a(g,a(h,i)).

source.place: Tag 03SF, finite Galois covers and permutation sets; connected-summand argument

proof.text: The nonzero principal open of Spec C contains the zero prime and is irreducible, hence connected. Each coproduct injection has clopen range: its complement is the union of the other open summands. The image of a connected scheme under a section lifted into the splitting lies in the summand containing its value at the zero prime. Factor the morphism through that open immersion; its projection to T is k, so composing with delta inverse and the first pullback projection reconstructs the split section with that evaluated label. Disjointness of summands and nonemptiness prove injectivity of the split-section indexing. Restrict Spec(rho(zeta)) itself, without an inverse. The restriction preserves Spec H because rho(zeta) fixes algebraMap H C. Cancellation against the principal-open immersion and Spec contravariance prove v(1)=id and v(ab)=v(a) followed by v(b), using rho(ab)=rho(a).comp(rho(b)). Precomposition and reconstruction, followed by injectivity, give a(1,i)=i and a(ab,i)=a(a,a(b,i)). These proofs include d=0 vacuously. No postponed theorem or chosen existence data is used.

proof_origin.note: Repair of reviewer X-e9fd4 point 4: forward deck convention, complete Lean reconstruction and label laws from Mathlib only.

theorem fixedPunctureLabel_laws
    (R H : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (ι : R →+* H)
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra H C] [IsDomain C]
    (G : Type u) [Group G] (ρ : G → C →ₐ[H] C)
    (hρone : ρ 1 = AlgHom.id H C)
    (hρmul : ∀ a b, ρ (a * b) = (ρ a).comp (ρ b))
    (hne : algebraMap H C (ι g) ≠ 0)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ Spec R)
    (k : Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) ⟶ T)
    (hk : k ≫ t = Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of C))
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H C (ι g))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H C)) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))
    (d : ℕ) (δ : pullback p t ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ T)
    (hδ : δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 T) = pullback.snd p t) :
    let a := fixedPunctureLabel R H g ι C G ρ hne p T t k hk d δ hδ
    (∀ i, a 1 i = i) ∧ (∀ ζ ξ i, a (ζ * ξ) i = a ζ (a ξ i))

old_proof.text: The principal open of Spec C is connected and nonempty because C is a domain and h is nonzero. Every section of the splitting pulled back along k has image in one coproduct summand; projection compatibility makes it the split section of that label. Read the label at the zero prime, exactly fixedPunctureLabel. The inverse deck map preserves the structural morphism to Spec H. Contravariance gives v(ab)=v(a) followed by v(b), and the identity and cocycle laws for the labels follow by precomposition and disjointness of the coproduct injections. No existence theorem chooses label data.
